_note: Animation library jobs for tools/retarget.gd. Current set: Mixamo packs (downloaded by the user, raw FBX kept outside the repo in D:/Godot/assets/mixamo) retargeted onto the Universal Base Characters body. Older sources (100STYLE, ACCAD, CMU) stay listed for later use. Clip fields: src, take, kind loop|action, face, ground, root_motion (ground travel on the root bone), strike (hand / foot timing meta), from/to, cycle, tags.
